o1.biggest_strength: Each ad set gets a clear verdict with rupee working, a budget table that adds to ₹5,60,000, and a creative brief in Rohan's and Ananya's words, so the team can start Monday.
o1.biggest_mistake: It scales Catalog DPA and ramps ASC while using the Meta-count break-even as the main yardstick. DPA at frequency 5.2 is probably over-counted, and the ₹282/₹394 two-line approach leaves the call ambiguous.
o1.what_would_make_it_a_10: Commit to one Shopify-adjusted break-even per ad set instead of two lines, and do not scale an over-counted, high-frequency DPA.

o2.biggest_strength: It sets a separate attribution-adjusted break-even for each ad set (86% for prospecting, 72% for retargeting and catalog), states the real account loss, and opens with concrete first moves: relaunch the creator video, cut Starter Kit and Gift Sets, narrow women to 25 to 34.
o2.biggest_mistake: It puts ₹56,000 into a UGC test running at ₹581 per purchase against a ₹359 break-even, and it labels Retargeting a "cut" while still giving it ₹28,000, so the call counts don't match the table.
o2.what_would_make_it_a_10: Fund the UGC test at a capped, smaller amount and make the retargeting label match its budget, and cut the geo-holdout section down to one line the team can run.

reason: Both reach the three key calls (relaunch the creator video, cut the Starter Kit COD trap, narrow women to 25 to 34) with budgets that add up. Output 2 judges every ad set on one attribution-adjusted break-even, opens with first moves, and adds a holdout test for retargeting. Output 1 is a bit easier to read and includes creative briefs, but it scales DPA and ASC on the more generous Meta-count lines.
